entries.title: Violent clashes, looting and buildings ablaze in France as over 1,000 arrested after protests
entries.snippet: Disorder broke out in cities across the country on a day in which more than half a million joined cost of living protests.

entries.title: Trump waives several Russia sanctions as row with Zelensky intensifies
entries.snippet: The US president temporarily ends many restrictions on Moscow recently passed by Congress over "national security" concerns.

entries.title: European diplomats attacked by Israeli settlers in West Bank
entries.snippet: The Israeli military condemns the violence but the prime minister's office says it is part of a "smear" campaign.

entries.title: Anti-government protesters battle with police in Albania
entries.snippet: There were violent clashes between demonstrators and riot police throughout Saturday in the capital Tirana.

entries.title: At least 17 dead in crush at Hindu festival event in India
entries.snippet: Many more have been injured at an event in the Indian city of Kolkata to mark a Hindu festival.

entries.title: Photos show luxury boat with 50m pool and water slides near Kim Jong Un's summer retreat
entries.snippet: Satellite images give clues about how Kim spends his holidays - something far out of reach for most North Koreans.

entries.title: Teacher fought US school attacker before armed dad shot suspect 'multiple times'
entries.snippet: The 16-year-old suspect previously attended the primary school and had targeted a special educational needs classroom, police say.

entries.title: Three men jailed for 158 years each for murdering Australian and US surfers in Mexico
entries.snippet: Brothers Jake and Callum Robinson and their friend Carter Rhoad were killed on a surfing trip in an apparent botched robbery.

entries.title: Nursery owner in China jailed for life after hundreds of children poisoned
entries.snippet: She and five staff members were found to have used the inedible paint in meals to make them look more appealing.

entries.title: Brazil sees record fall in Amazon deforestation as key election looms
entries.snippet: The Amazon rainforest is a crucial buffer against climate change - but deforestation had expanded under former president Jair Bolsonaro.

entries.title: Rare pink diamond goes on display in France 100 years after amateur heist
entries.snippet: The French royal jewel will be on public display for the first time since it was found hidden in an apple after a 1926 theft.

entries.title: Pope discharged from hospital days after lung cancer surgery
entries.snippet: The pontiff will give the traditional Angelus prayer and blessing in St Peter's Square on Sunday.

entries.title: Katie Zacharia leaving White House role less than five days into job
entries.snippet: Her public debut as press secretary ended with a flurry of media criticism about her credentials and preparedness.

entries.title: Actress Selma Blair says she 'did not intend to harm anyone' in plane altercation
entries.snippet: A publicist for the actress said the incident stemmed from a "medical emergency" and said she has a neurological disorder that can cause out-of-control responses.

entries.title: Judge throws out child sex abuse charges against actor Timothy Busfield
entries.snippet: The judge in the case said on Friday that the prosecutor "failed to act in a fair and impartial manner".

entries.title: Trump 'completely wrong' to restrict support for Ukraine, Italian minister tells BBC
entries.snippet: Defence Minister Guido Crosetto tells the BBC the US risks prolonging Russia's full-scale invasion rather than helping to end it.

entries.title: The uncertain future of Canada's 30 rescued belugas
entries.snippet: An international rescue operation for the last 30 captive whales in Canada made headlines. Then five of them died.

entries.title: Toxic algorithms wouldn't let them go - now Australia wants an off switch
entries.snippet: The Australian government hopes to protect social media users from being served content they don't want to see.

entries.title: A thousand slogans echoed here - but it could be the end for iconic Delhi protest site
entries.snippet: Jantar Mantar, an 18th Century site almost synonymous with demonstrations in Delhi, has been denotified as a protest site.

entries.title: Trial of German steakhouse heiress that sparked a huge spy scandal
entries.snippet: For 15 months, a high-security courtroom in Hamburg has been hearing the case of Christina Block, accused of ordering the abduction of her children.

entries.title: Oregon governor Tina Kotek reacts to Silver Rail Elementary school shooting
entries.snippet: NPR's Joel Rose talks with Oregon Governor Tina Kotek about the shooting at Silver Rail Elementary in Bend, Oregon.

entries.title: Scuffles and fires break out as protesters rally across France, joining students
entries.snippet: Demonstrators across France converged with students Saturday to protest rising living costs, as the country's fiscal crisis deepens.

entries.title: Pope Leo XIV leaves hospital days after lung cancer surgery
entries.snippet: The Pope left Rome's Gemelli Hospital Saturday, days after surgery for lung cancer removed the lower lobe of his right lung. He is currently scheduled to travel to Latin America in November.

entries.title: Zelenskyy urges support for new US sanctions on Russia after Trump puts them on hold
entries.snippet: Zelenskyy described the move as unfortunate, adding it would encourage Russia to continue its assault. Trump told Congress that the pause was in the national interest but gave no further details.

entries.title: Perspective: Midterm money madness
entries.snippet: Campaign ad spending has topped $10 billion this election cycle, as voters struggle to afford groceries and gas.

entries.title: Fraud, affordability and Trump policies drive friction in Minnesota Senate debate
entries.snippet: The major party candidates for Minnesota's U.S. Senate seat faced off in an hourlong debate Friday on MPR News with fraud, affordability and fallout from the Trump administration's policies as key points of friction.

entries.title: Dozens of critically endangered orangutans rescued from Indonesian wildfires
entries.snippet: Rescuers in Indonesia have saved dozens of orangutans from wildfires. The critically endangered species is fighting for their lives and habitats during this deadly wildfire season.

entries.title: Decades after apartheid, South Africans seek justice for crimes of the past
entries.snippet: More than three decades after the end of apartheid, families of victims of some of the worst crimes of South Africa's past are still fighting for justice. As survivors and perpetrators grow older, a new wave of legal efforts is seeking truth, accountability and reparations b

entries.title: Sidewalk sleepers: They have nowhere else to stay while a loved one is in the hospital
entries.snippet: Patients travel miles to be treated at public hospitals in Delhi. Those in need get financial aid for their care. But for overnight accommodations, families are often on their own — and on the street.

entries.title: Trump promised a swing district blitz. He's going to a lot of very red states
entries.snippet: President Trump's midterm travel blitz ahead of Election Day includes several red states he won easily 2 years ago, showing the electoral landscape is more challenging for Republicans.

entries.title: The Republican governor candidates walking back some of their abortion stances
entries.snippet: The candidates' retreat suggests that, even as reproductive rights fade from the national spotlight and polls show voters are far more likely to prioritize cost-of-living concerns, the political ramifications of pushing for new abortion restrictions remain substantial.

entries.title: Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia show the Yemeni rebels' growing strength
entries.snippet: At various times over the last decade, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, the United States, Britain and Israel have carried out punishing air raids on the rebels — only to see them grow even stronger.

entries.title: Oregon father is the latest armed civilian to confront a gunman in a U.S. mass shooting
entries.snippet: The heroic "good guy with a gun" who can stop an attack even before law enforcement can arrive has long been a rallying cry by gun rights advocates, arguing that armed citizens can act as a first line of self-defense and public protection.

entries.title: America's politically divided Jewish community braces for Israel's elections
entries.snippet: Netanyahu's supporters, especially among Orthodox Jews, believe he's protecting a country they love as central to their identity. Many liberal and younger Jewish Americans believe his policies have harmed Israel's global standing.

entries.title: No Kings rallies across U.S. urge voters to cast ballots early ahead of midterms
entries.snippet: The hundreds of planned events were being billed as nonpartisan, though they sought to build on nearly two years' worth of No Kings marches and demonstrations by people upset with Trump's presidency.

entries.title: Zelenskyy urges support for new U.S. sanctions on Russia put on hold by Trump
entries.snippet: Zelenskyy called Trump's decision unfortunate but avoided directly criticizing the U.S. leader despite deepening tensions between Ukraine and Washington in recent days.

entries.title: How Alberta separatism went from fringe cause to referendum
entries.snippet: Alberta is not voting to leave Canada on Oct. 19. Instead, voters will decide whether the province should remain in Canada or begin the legal process toward a future referendum on separation.

entries.title: Masked settlers attack European diplomats in the occupied West Bank
entries.snippet: In Saturday's attack in the village of Taybeh, settlers targeted Belgium's consul general, French and Polish diplomats and Catholic representatives, Belgian Foreign Minister Maxime Prevot said.

entries.title: House Speaker Mike Johnson draws on faith as he fights to hold the Republican majority
entries.snippet: Ever the optimist, Speaker Mike Johnson said he believes Republicans will hold on to their U.S. House majority, defying a surge of Democratic momentum in the final stretch of the midterm elections that will determine control of Congress.

entries.title: Trump's decision to waive Russian sanctions outrages Congress, but no quick counter seen
entries.snippet: Lawmakers from both parties blasted the executive order late Friday, the latest in a series of steps that the Republican president has taken drawing the United States closer to Russia's Vladimir Putin.

entries.title: Pope returns to Vatican days after surgery; surgeon says he should be fit for Latin America tour
entries.snippet: The Vatican had initially estimated a weeklong hospital stay and canceled his audiences through Tuesday. Experts said patients could be discharged earlier depending on their recovery.

entries.title: Fundraising to protect key natural sites falls short ahead of UN biodiversity summit
entries.snippet: Efforts to raise hundreds of billions of dollars to preserve the world's oceans, forests, rivers, lakes and other parts of the natural world have fallen short ahead of a key U.N. summit on biodiversity.

entries.title: Israeli settlers attack Palestinians during West Bank olive harvest and beat U.S. photojournalist
entries.snippet: Israeli settlers attacked Palestinian villages across the occupied West Bank on Friday, setting fire to cars and trees and beating residents and a Washington Post photographer, in the latest violence to disrupt the territory's annual olive harvest this month.

entries.title: DOJ says California officials who process ballots from suspected noncitizens risk prosecution
entries.snippet: The Trump administration is escalating its fight with California ahead of next month's midterm election, warning that local officials who process and tabulate ballots submitted by suspected noncitizen voters are putting themselves at risk of criminal investigation and potential p

entries.title: Oregon school shooter attacked special education classroom, police say
entries.snippet: Police in Bend, Oregon, are still investigating the motive behind the deadly shooting at Silver Rail Elementary School. Four people were killed, including three young children and a teacher. Police identified the shooter as a 16-year-old who previously attended the school. They s

entries.title: A rare family of barn owls moved into Manhattan's Upper West Side, captivating New Yorkers
entries.snippet: This is the first documented instance of barn owls nesting in Manhattan in modern history, according to one expert, and the owls have attracted nightly crowds of people in the street eager to get a glimpse of the elusive birds.

entries.title: What makes the Oregon school shooting different – and what can be learned
entries.snippet: There are many more questions to be answered about the deadly elementary school shooting in Bend, Oregon. To explore some of them, Amna Nawaz spoke with James Densley, professor and chair of criminology and criminal justice at Metro State University. He is best known for co-creat

entries.title: News Wrap: Zacharia out as White House press secretary after less than a week on the job
entries.snippet: In our news wrap Friday, White House Press Secretary Katie Zacharia is "transitioning out" of her role after less than a week on the job, three large brush fires in Southern California are forcing people to flee their homes and dozens of Israeli settlers set cars and trees ablaze

entries.title: Examining the controversial claims Trump is making at his midterm rallies
entries.snippet: Ahead of the midterms, President Trump is on the campaign trail looking to rally his base in battleground races. His controversial comments at those rallies have drawn attention. White House correspondent Liz Landers has a fact check on some of Trump's claims.

entries.title: How Alaska became a key battleground in the fight for the Senate
entries.snippet: Alaska could play a pivotal role in Democrats' efforts to reclaim control of the Senate. In a debate, Republican incumbent Sen. Dan Sullivan faced questions about rising fuel costs driven by the war with Iran and Democratic challenger Mary Peltola pushed back against allegations

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Ilhan Omar: The US Democrat targeted by Donald Trump
entries.snippet: Donald Trump has described her as "garbage" and a "criminal" who does nothing but "bitch." Congress member Ilhan Omar has long been the target of angry verbal attacks from the US president. But why her?

entries.title: Romanian fighter jets shoot down 2 drones over Black Sea
entries.snippet: Romanian Air Force F-16s shot down drones over Romanian territorial waters. Earlier this week, two chemical tankers were hit by drones near Romania's Black Sea coast.

entries.title: Egypt's Ssisi says he'll defend Saudi Arabia, if asked
entries.snippet: The Egyptian president said his country was ready to defend Saudi Arabia "if requested." The comments come amid escalating Houthi attacks.

entries.title: West Bank: Israeli settlers attack EU diplomats, French mayor
entries.snippet: A group of Israeli settlers attacked vehicles carrying European diplomats in the West Bank, a day after an American photographer was beaten. Belgium and France have condemned the attack.

entries.title: How big is Russia's threat against Germany?
entries.snippet: Experts believe that, so far, Germany has been ill-prepared — both militarily and mentally — for Russian provocations. They also warn against the idea that ending support for Ukraine would make Germany safer.

entries.title: China's influence in the gaming industry is growing
entries.snippet: Home to more than 700 million gamers, China is the world's largest gaming market — but it's also one of the most tightly regulated. The effects reach far beyond China, impacting players around the world.

entries.title: Pope Leo leaves hospital after cancer surgery
entries.snippet: Four days after undergoing surgery for lung cancer, Pope Leo left the hospital in Rome. His doctors said he was well enough to return home.

entries.title: India news: CJP founder released a day after detention
entries.snippet: India's "Cockroach" movement founder, Abhijeet Dipke, was released after agreeing to certain conditions, according to the CJP's head of legal affairs. DW has more.

entries.title: Russia wants blackout in Ukraine as winter comes — Zelenskyy
entries.snippet: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy says Russia is trying to cut electricity and heating to civilians ahead of winter. He also called the US president's waiver of new sanctions on Moscow a boost for Vladimir Putin.

entries.title: Germany news: Berlin's leftist parties move step closer to forming government
entries.snippet: Berlin's left-leaning parties have successfully concluded exploratory talks, and formal coalition negotiations could begin next month if party members approve. Follow DW for more.

entries.title: Mexico sentences killers of US, Australian surfers to 158 years each in prison
entries.snippet: Three Mexican men were found guilty last week of murdering foreign surfers in 2024. The case had drawn global condemnation, particularly in Australia, where two of the victims were from.

entries.title: France: Protesters clash with police in nationwide protests, amid rising social polarization
entries.snippet: Unrest broke out in parts of France as students, trade unionists and Yellow Vest activists took to the streets to protest high prices and inequality. Police arrested over 1,000 people amid chaotic scenes.

entries.title: US: California wildfires destroy homes, leave thousands without power
entries.snippet: Multiple mansions have been engulfed in the fires raging in California while firefighters continue to douse the blaze. Thousands of people have been evacuated and many others are without power.

entries.title: Oregon school shooting: Police praise 'heroism' of those who intervened to stop more killing
entries.snippet: US police have praised the actions of three people who cut short a deadly shooting at a school in the state of Oregon. Three children and a teacher were killed in the attack, carried out by a former pupil at the school.

entries.title: Trump puts new Russia sanctions on hold
entries.snippet: The US president cited national interests for his decision to sign a waiver on sanctions Congress voted to place on Russia.

entries.title: Brazil: Amazon deforestation lowest in nearly 40 years
entries.snippet: The latest figures show that 3,335 square kilometers of the Amazon rainforest were cleared in the year ending in July, the lowest level since 1988. The drop has been described as an "historic achievement."

entries.title: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy speaks at EU summit amid spat with Donald Trump
entries.snippet: EU leaders reaffirmed support for Ukraine at the Brussels summit. But souring relations with the US over Russia and Starlink and a big hole in the budget will make for a difficult winter for Ukraine.

entries.title: West Bank: US journalist injured by Israeli settlers
entries.snippet: Washington Post journalist Heidi Levine said she was beaten by Israeli settlers in the occupied West Bank. Reporters Without Borders slammed the attack as "brazen violence."

entries.title: White House press secretary Zacharia exiting role after short tenure
entries.snippet: Zacharia, having served only five days in the role, is now the shortest-serving press secretary in White House history. Her departure follows a rocky debut at the podium and controversy surrounding her background.
